# AtlasDays

> AtlasDays is a private iPhone app for tracking visa limits, residency or tax presence days, and accurate travel history. On-device, no account required.

AtlasDays provides general information, not legal, tax, or immigration advice. Rules change and outcomes depend on your circumstances, so never rely on it alone: check the linked official source or ask a qualified professional.

## Start Here

- [AtlasDays – Private Day Tracking for Visa, Residency, and Travel History](https://atlasdays.app/): AtlasDays is a private iPhone app for tracking visa limits, residency or tax presence days, and accurate travel history. On-device, no account required.
- [View on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/atlasdays-track-country-days/id6760133544): Private travel-day tracking for iPhone.

## Use Cases

- [Residency Thresholds – Track 183-Day and Tax Presence Rules](https://atlasdays.app/residency-thresholds): Track 183-day tax residency tests, statutory residence rules, and citizenship absence limits side by side, each on its own calendar, and export the record.
- [Travel History – Rebuild and Export Your Trip Record](https://atlasdays.app/travel-history): Rebuild a travel history from photos, CSV, or a Flighty flight history, keep uncertain trips honest, and export trips and days for a visa application.
- [Visa Limits – Track Schengen 90/180 and Stay Limits](https://atlasdays.app/visa-limits): Track Schengen 90/180, single-entry visas, per-stay caps, and rolling windows against your real trips. See days used, days left, and the date you have to leave by.

## Help

- [Help Center](https://atlasdays.app/help/): Use the AtlasDays Help Center for setup, Photo, CSV, and Flighty import, US state tracking, trip records, trackers, widgets, exports, privacy, and iCloud sync.
- [Auto-Detect Trips](https://atlasdays.app/help/auto-detect-trips): Enable AtlasDays Auto-Detect Trips, grant the required location access, and review trips added after border crossings.

- [CSV Format Reference](https://atlasdays.app/help/csv-format-reference): Reference the supported AtlasDays CSV headers, exact-date and year formats, US states, Transit, purposes, notes, and examples.
- [CSV Import](https://atlasdays.app/help/csv-import): Import a prepared CSV travel history into AtlasDays and review valid rows, errors, duplicates, and overlaps before saving.
- [Understanding the Dashboard and Map](https://atlasdays.app/help/dashboard-and-map): See how Dashboard periods, Home Country, trip precision, and visit rules shape AtlasDays totals and map highlights.
- [How AtlasDays Counts Travel Days](https://atlasdays.app/help/day-counting): Understand inclusive arrival and departure days, overlaps, ongoing trips, approximate records, and Transit in AtlasDays.
- [Delete Data or Start Over](https://atlasdays.app/help/delete-and-reset): Delete selected AtlasDays data or reset the app after understanding what the action removes and whether iCloud is involved.
- [Export and Reports](https://atlasdays.app/help/export-and-reports): Export AtlasDays travel history as an AtlasDays Backup, configurable spreadsheet, or PDF report.
- [Flighty Import](https://atlasdays.app/help/flighty-import): Import a Flighty CSV into AtlasDays and review the stays, transit days, and overnight travel inferred from its flights.
- [Getting Started](https://atlasdays.app/help/getting-started): What AtlasDays does, how to fill your Timeline from photos and Auto-Detect instead of typing, and how to add your first tracker.
- [How Trip Dates Work](https://atlasdays.app/help/history-and-import): Record a trip's arrival and departure dates, leave a stay ongoing, or save just the year with Year Only in AtlasDays.
- [iCloud Sync and Restore](https://atlasdays.app/help/icloud-sync-and-restore): Set up AtlasDays iCloud Sync, check its status, and understand new-device, reinstall, and missing-data behavior.
- [Photo Import](https://atlasdays.app/help/photo-import): Use photo location metadata to suggest AtlasDays trips, then review dates, countries, duplicates, and overlaps before saving.
- [Check Whether a Planned Trip Fits](https://atlasdays.app/help/plan-a-trip): Add a future trip in AtlasDays and use the tracker forecast to see whether it stays inside your limit.
- [Privacy and Permissions](https://atlasdays.app/help/privacy-location-and-sync): Understand AtlasDays local-first travel data, Photos and location access, notifications, analytics, and iCloud storage.
- [Track the Schengen 90/180 Rule](https://atlasdays.app/help/schengen-90-180): Set up the Schengen 90/180 tracker in AtlasDays and read the days you have used and the days you have left.
- [Smart Alerts](https://atlasdays.app/help/smart-alerts): Configure AtlasDays Smart Alerts for tracker thresholds and understand when notifications can appear.
- [Add, Edit, or Delete a Trip](https://atlasdays.app/help/timeline-and-calendar): Use the AtlasDays Timeline or Calendar to add a trip, correct its details, or remove it from your travel history.
- [How Tracker Totals Are Calculated](https://atlasdays.app/help/trackers-and-limits): Understand how an AtlasDays tracker combines selected places, exact trip days, window type, and limit.
- [Home Screen Widgets](https://atlasdays.app/help/widgets): Add AtlasDays tracker and world-map widgets to the iPhone Home Screen and choose what each widget displays.
- [Appearance and Personalization](https://atlasdays.app/help/appearance-and-personalization): Change the AtlasDays theme, accent color, background wash, and app icon without changing travel data or calculations.
- [AtlasDays Pro](https://atlasdays.app/help/atlasdays-pro): Compare free AtlasDays with Pro features including unlimited trackers, Smart Alerts, exports, US states, and Tracker Trend widgets.
- [AtlasDays on iPad](https://atlasdays.app/help/ipad): Use AtlasDays two-pane Timeline and Settings layouts and expanded Dashboard map on iPad.
- [Languages and Country Names](https://atlasdays.app/help/languages): Choose the AtlasDays interface language, country-name language, and language used for exports and share cards.

## Learn

- [US State Tax Residency: 183-Day Rules by State](https://atlasdays.app/learn/us-state-tax-residency): Browse US state tax residency rules. Find the day threshold and statutory-residence basis for each state, and how to calculate residency, with the official state source.
- [Travel Rules and Guides by Place or Topic](https://atlasdays.app/learn/): Search AtlasDays travel rules and guides, browse rules by country or US state, or read general articles about day counting and travel records.
- [183-Day Tax Residency Rule: What Travelers Need to Know](https://atlasdays.app/learn/183-day-tax-residency-rule): What people usually mean by the 183-day tax residency rule, why it is common but not universal, and where day counting stops being the whole answer.
- [Albania 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/albania-183-day-tax-residency): Albania's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more in a calendar year is one route to tax residency. How to count it, plus the other residence tests and the official source.
- [Arizona's 9-Month Residency Presumption Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/arizona-tax-residency): Arizona's residency rule in plain terms: spending more than nine months (about 270 days) of the tax year in Arizona presumes you are a resident, unless you rebut it. How to count it, and the official source.
- [Armenia 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/armenia-183-day-tax-residency): Armenia's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more in a calendar year is one route to tax residency. How to count it, plus the centre-of-vital-interests test and the official source.
- [Australia's 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/australia-183-day-tax-residency): Australia's 183-day test in plain terms: 183 or more days in an income year presumes you are a resident for tax, unless your usual place of abode is outside Australia. How to count it and the official ATO source.
- [Australia Citizenship: The 365-Day and 90-Day Absence Limits](https://atlasdays.app/learn/australia-citizenship-residence-requirement): How Australia’s citizenship absence limits work across four years and the final year, with travel-day examples, included territories and residence-status requirements.
- [Australia's Resident Return Visa 730-Day Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/australia-resident-return-visa-residence): Australia's Resident Return visa explained: the five-year subclass 155 needs 730 days in Australia over the last 5 years. How to count them, with sources.
- [Bulgaria 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/bulgaria-183-day-tax-residency): Bulgaria's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: more than 183 days in any rolling 12-month period makes you a Bulgarian tax resident. How to count it, plus the permanent-address and centre-of-vital-interests tests and the official source.
- [California Tax Residency and the Nine-Month Presumption Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/california-tax-residency): California has no fixed day-count line for residency. It is a closest-connections test, but spending more than nine months (about 270 days) in California in a tax year creates a rebuttable presumption of residency. How the count works, and the official source.
- [Canada's 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/canada-183-day-tax-residency): Canada's 183-day rule in plain terms: sojourn 183 days or more in a calendar year and you are a deemed resident taxed on worldwide income. Plus the residential-ties test, how to count, and the official CRA source.
- [Canada Citizenship Physical Presence: The 1,095-Day Rule](https://atlasdays.app/learn/canada-citizenship-physical-presence): Canadian citizenship needs 1,095 days physically in Canada in the five years before you apply. How to count them, travel days, and pre-PR half-day credit.
- [Canada PR Residency Obligation: 730 Days in Five Years](https://atlasdays.app/learn/canada-pr-residency-obligation): Canada's permanent resident residency obligation: at least 730 days physically in Canada in every five-year period, and how the count works.
- [Canada's 6-Month Visitor Limit Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/canada-visitor-visa-6-month-limit): Canada's visitor limit in plain terms: most visitors may stay up to 6 months per entry on a visitor visa or eTA. What the border officer's stamp changes, what happens with no stamp, and how to extend, with the official source.
- [Colombia 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/colombia-183-day-tax-residency): Colombia's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: more than 183 days in any rolling 365-day period makes you a tax resident. How to count it, what happens when days straddle two years, and the official source.
- [Colorado's Six-Month (183-Day) Statutory Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/colorado-tax-residency): Colorado's six-month rule in plain terms: a permanent place of abode plus more than six months (more than 183 days) in Colorado in the tax year makes you a statutory resident. How to count it, and the official source.
- [Connecticut's 183-Day Statutory Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/connecticut-tax-residency): Connecticut's 183-day rule in plain terms: a permanent place of abode plus more than 183 days in Connecticut in a taxable year makes you a statutory resident. How to count it, and the official source.
- [Country Counting Rules: Every Major List Compared](https://atlasdays.app/learn/country-counting-rules-every-list-compared): How major country-counting systems differ, what they are actually trying to count, and why travel totals stop being comparable when the list is unclear.
- [Cyprus 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/cyprus-183-day-tax-residency): Cyprus's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: spending more than 183 days in Cyprus in a calendar year makes you a tax resident, and a separate 60-day rule can apply too. How to count it, plus the official source.
- [Cyprus Citizenship: The Final-Year 90-Day Absence Limit](https://atlasdays.app/learn/cyprus-citizenship-final-year-absence): How Cyprus's final-year citizenship absence allowance works, how to total separate trips, and why the application date and lawful residence still matter.
- [Czech Republic 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/czech-republic-183-day-tax-residency): The Czech Republic's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: at least 183 days in a calendar year makes you a tax resident. How to count it, plus the permanent-home test and the official source.
- [Denmark's 42-Day Rule for Work Abroad](https://atlasdays.app/learn/denmark-overseas-work-42-day-rule): How Denmark counts visits during overseas work for tax relief: rolling six-month periods, partial days, the outer travel-day exclusion and the separate work conditions.
- [Digital Nomad Visa Day Limits: A Country-by-Country Overview](https://atlasdays.app/learn/digital-nomad-visa-day-limits): A practical overview of how common nomad destinations frame short stays, extensions, and longer remote-work routes, without pretending one summary can replace official programme rules.
- [Does a Layover Count as Visiting a Country?](https://atlasdays.app/learn/does-a-layover-count-as-visiting-a-country): How to think about layovers for immigration, day counting, and personal travel lists without pretending those questions all have the same answer.

How to count it, plus the permanent-home test and the official source.

- [Turn Your Flighty Flight History Into a Visa Day Count](https://atlasdays.app/learn/flighty-flight-history-day-count): Flighty tracks your flights, not your days in each country. Here's how to turn your Flighty flight history into a visa and residency day count you can trust.
- [France's Ten-Year Resident Card: The Three-Year Absence Rule](https://atlasdays.app/learn/france-resident-card-absence): How a continuous absence can affect a French ten-year resident card, why three calendar years are not always 1095 days, and what to check before returning.
- [Georgia (Country) 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/georgia-183-day-tax-residency): Georgia's (the country) 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 or more days in any continuous 12-month period ending in the tax year makes you a tax resident. How to count it, plus the official source.
- [Georgia's 183-Day Tax Residency Rule (the US State) Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/georgia-us-tax-residency): Georgia the US state taxes you as a resident if you spend 183 days or more in Georgia during any 12 consecutive months, not just a calendar year. How the rolling day count works, and the official source.
- [Georgia's One-Year Visa-Free Stay Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/georgia-visa-free-365-days): Georgia's visa-free regime in plain terms: citizens of listed countries may stay one full year per entry. How the continuous year is counted, what exit and re-entry change, and how it differs from tax residency, with the official source.
- [Germany's Six-Month Naturalisation Absence Limit](https://atlasdays.app/learn/germany-naturalization-absence-limit): A stay abroad of up to six months does not interrupt the habitual residence German naturalisation requires. How § 12b StAG counts a single absence.
- [Greece 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/greece-183-day-tax-residency): Greece's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: more than 183 days in any 12-month period makes you a tax resident from your first day. How to count it, the centre of vital interests test, and the official source.

How the presumption works, how to rebut it, and the official source.

- [What Does 90 Days in Any 180-Day Period Mean?](https://atlasdays.app/learn/schengen-90-180-rule): The Schengen 90-day rule in Europe means up to 90 total days in the Schengen area within any rolling 180-day period. Plain-English explanation and examples.
- [Schengen Countries List for the 90/180 Rule](https://atlasdays.app/learn/schengen-countries-list-90-180-rule): Which countries count together under the Schengen 90/180 short-stay rule, and why EU membership is not the same thing as Schengen membership.
- [How the Schengen Rolling Window Actually Works](https://atlasdays.app/learn/schengen-rolling-window-walkthrough): A practical walkthrough of how the Schengen 90/180 rolling window works, why days return one by one, and where manual counting goes wrong.
- [Schengen Single-Entry Visa: Entries vs Duration of Stay](https://atlasdays.app/learn/schengen-single-entry-visa): What a Schengen single-entry visa means: how to read the number of entries, the duration of stay, and the validity dates on a uniform (type C) visa. Once you leave, a single-entry visa is used up.
- [Serbia 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/serbia-183-day-tax-residency): Serbia's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more in any rolling 12-month period makes you a tax resident. How to count it, plus the domicile and vital-interests tests and the official source.
- [Singapore 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/singapore-183-day-tax-residency): Singapore's tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more of presence or employment in a calendar year makes you a Singapore tax resident. How to count it, the concessions, and the official source.
- [Slovakia 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/slovakia-183-day-tax-residency): Slovakia's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: at least 183 days in a calendar year is one route to tax residency. How to count it, plus the permanent-residence and dwelling tests and the official source.
- [Slovenia 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/slovenia-183-day-tax-residency): Slovenia's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: more than 183 days in a calendar year is one route to tax residency. How to count it, plus the other residence tests and the official source.
- [Spain Long-Term Residence: The 12-Month Absence from the EU](https://atlasdays.app/learn/spain-long-term-residence-eu-absence): Spain's standard long-term-residence absence rule measures time outside the EU, not just Spain. How the territory, calendar period and Blue Card exception fit together.
- [Swiss B and C Permits: Six Months Abroad and Keeping Your Permit](https://atlasdays.app/learn/switzerland-permit-absence): How absence and deregistration affect Swiss B/C permits, when a C permit can be retained, and why a short return visit does not necessarily reset the legal clock.
- [Taiwan 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/taiwan-183-day-tax-residency): Taiwan's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more in a taxable year is one route to tax residency if you have no domicile there. How to count it and the official source.
- [Thailand 180-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/thailand-180-day-tax-residency): Thailand's tax residency rule in plain terms: 180 days or more in a calendar year makes you a Thai tax resident. How to count it, what it means for foreign income, and the official source.
- [How to Prepare Travel History for a Visa Application](https://atlasdays.app/learn/travel-history-for-visa-applications): What a travel-history record for a visa application usually needs to do, what makes it usable or weak, and where official application instructions take priority.
- [Travel History Template for Visa Applications](https://atlasdays.app/learn/travel-history-template-visa-application): What a travel-history template is for, why no single template works everywhere, what fields to include, and what to verify before relying on one in a formal submission.
- [Turkiye's 90/180 Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/turkiye-90-180-rule): Turkiye's 90/180 short-stay rule in plain terms: at most 90 days within any rolling 180-day period on a visa or visa exemption. How the rolling window is counted, with a worked example and the official source.
- [UAE 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/uae-183-day-tax-residency): The UAE's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more in any consecutive 12-month period makes you a UAE tax resident. How to count it, the 90-day test, and the official source.
- [UK Citizenship: The 450-Day and 90-Day Absence Limits](https://atlasdays.app/learn/uk-citizenship-absence-limits): How UK naturalisation absence limits work: 450 days over five years, 90 in the final year, whole-day counting, Crown Dependencies and the three-year route.
- [UK ETA vs Standard Visitor Visa: What's the Difference?](https://atlasdays.app/learn/uk-eta-vs-standard-visitor-visa): How the UK ETA and Standard Visitor visa differ, when the distinction matters, and why neither one should be treated as guaranteed entry by itself.
- [UK ILR Absence Limits: What Continuous Residence Is Trying to Show](https://atlasdays.app/learn/uk-ilr-absence-limit): What UK ILR absence limits are trying to measure, why many routes use a 180-days-in-any-12-months style test, and why route, qualifying period, and rule version matter.
- [The UK Standard Visitor "180-Day Rule"](https://atlasdays.app/learn/uk-standard-visitor-visa-180-day-rule): UK Standard Visitor rules allow up to 6 months per visit. There is no published 180-days-per-year formula; officers assess your pattern of visits instead.
- [UK Statutory Residence Test: What Travelers Need to Know](https://atlasdays.app/learn/uk-statutory-residence-test): What the UK Statutory Residence Test is trying to determine, why it is not a simple 183-day rule, and how automatic tests, sufficient ties, and prior residence change the analysis.
- [US B1/B2 Visa: Understanding the 180-Day Stay Limit](https://atlasdays.app/learn/us-b1-b2-visa-180-day-limit): The B-1/B-2 visa's expiration date does not set your stay. CBP typically admits visitors for up to 6 months per entry; the I-94 admitted-until date controls.
- [US Green Card Absence Limits: Six Months and One Year](https://atlasdays.app/learn/us-green-card-absence-limits): How long a green card holder can stay outside the United States: six months puts continuous residence at risk, one year breaks it. How the days count.
- [US Naturalisation: The 30-Month Physical Presence Rule](https://atlasdays.app/learn/us-naturalization-physical-presence): US naturalisation needs 30 months (913 days) of physical presence in the five years before filing Form N-400. How USCIS counts the days.
- [US Substantial Presence Test: What Travelers Need to Know](https://atlasdays.app/learn/us-substantial-presence-test): What the U.S. substantial presence test is trying to determine, why it is not a simple 183-day rule, and where exceptions, treaties, and professional advice matter.
- [US Visa Waiver Program 90-Day Limit Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/us-visa-waiver-90-day-limit): The US Visa Waiver Program in plain terms: with an approved ESTA you may be admitted for up to 90 days per visit. How the limit works, why nearby-country trips don't reset it, and the official source.
- [Vermont's 183-Day Statutory Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/vermont-tax-residency): Vermont's 183-day rule in plain terms: a permanent place of abode plus more than 183 days in Vermont in the taxable year makes you a statutory resident. How to count it, and the official source.
- [Vietnam 183-Day Tax Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/vietnam-183-day-tax-residency): Vietnam's 183-day tax residency rule in plain terms: 183 days or more in a calendar year or any 12-month period makes you a Vietnamese tax resident. How to count it, plus the official source.
- [Virginia's 183-Day Actual Residency Rule Explained](https://atlasdays.app/learn/virginia-tax-residency): Virginia's 183-day rule in plain terms: maintaining a place of abode in Virginia for more than 183 days in the taxable year makes you an actual resident, even if domiciled elsewhere. How to count it, and the official source.
- [What Counts as a 'Day' for Visa Purposes?](https://atlasdays.app/learn/what-counts-as-a-day-for-visa-purposes): What people usually mean when they ask what counts as a day, why the answer is not universal, and where entry, exit, transit, and regime differences start to matter.
- [When Do You Get Schengen Days Back After a 90-Day Stay?](https://atlasdays.app/learn/when-do-you-get-schengen-days-back-after-90-day-stay): When Schengen days come back after a long stay, why they return one by one, and why there is no lump-sum reset.
- [EES and ETIAS: What They Mean for Your Schengen Days](https://atlasdays.app/learn/ees-etias-schengen-90-180): EES replaced Schengen passport stamping with a digital entry/exit record in April 2026 and ETIAS is expected late 2026. Neither changes the 90 days in any 180-day period allowance.
